candidates.description: Write a function to find the median of two sorted arrays of same size.
candidates.code:
def get_median(arr1, arr2, n):
  i = 0
  j = 0
  m1 = -1
  m2 = -1
  count = 0
  while count < n + 1:
    count += 1
    if i == n:
      m1 = m2
      m2 = arr2[0]
      break
    elif j == n:
      m1 = m2
      m2 = arr1[0]
      break
    if arr1[i] <= arr2[j]:
      m1 = m2
      m2 = arr1[i]
      i += 1
    else:
      m1 = m2
      m2 = arr2[j]
      j += 1
  return (m1 + m2)/2

def count_Fac(n):  
    m = n 
    count = 0
    i = 2
    while((i * i) <= m): 
        total = 0
        while (n % i == 0): 
            n /= i 
            total += 1 
        temp = 0
        j = 1
        while((temp + j) <= total): 
            temp += j 
            count += 1
            j += 1 
        i += 1
    if (n != 1): 
        count += 1 
    return count

candidates.description: Write a python function to find sum of odd factors of a number.
candidates.code:
import math
def sum_of_odd_Factors(n): 
    res = 1
    while n % 2 == 0: 
        n = n // 2 
    for i in range(3,int(math.sqrt(n) + 1)): 
        count = 0
        curr_sum = 1
        curr_term = 1
        while n % i == 0: 
            count+=1 
            n = n // i 
            curr_term *= i 
            curr_sum += curr_term    
        res *= curr_sum  
    if n >= 2: 
        res *= (1 + n) 
    return res
